steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Switch the default single-stage event type to RFQ.
Every create flow requires a title before publication.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is created.
Verify that the RFQ template was applied and the picker no longer offers Select Templates.
Add the requested product and quantity through the catalog's line-item flow.
Populate the pricing sheet fields required by the create screen.
Enter the requested delivery location in the first line-item row.
Verify the requested quantity was retained.
Verify the requested delivery location is shown in the sheet.
Configure the available one-hour duration; the catalog cannot set the requested absolute future start.
Invite one QA test vendor without inventing a company name.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Return to the events list to verify the newly published event is listed.
Open the Live tab named by the case.
Verify that this plan's published RFQ appears in the Live events list.
